# FontRegistrationOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Optional names supplied when registering in-memory font bytes. `identifier` binds the bytes to the exact document font reference (commonly a browser URL) so export does not need to fetch that resource a second time.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`family`](#family): Family name to register the font under.
- [`identifier`](#identifier): Explicit identifier for the font, used instead of one built from family and style.
- [`subfamily`](#subfamily): Style name, such as `Bold` or `Italic`.

### `family`

```typescript
family?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Family name to register the font under. Read from the font file when omitted.

### `identifier`

```typescript
identifier?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Explicit identifier for the font, used instead of one built from family and style.

### `subfamily`

```typescript
subfamily?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Style name, such as `Bold` or `Italic`. Read from the font file when omitted.
